meta.description: Category 3 answer key: per-turn handbook facts (turns 1-9), turn-10 ledger facts, and turn-11 recall probes for desk-01 and desk-02. Derived only from IT_HR_HANDBOOK_MARKDOWN, each preset's employee_profile and the scripted user messages in app/data/cat3_fixtures.py; never from model replies.
meta.matching: A fact is hit when ANY any_of alternative occurs in the reply after both sides are normalised by quality_rerun.normalise_text(), with a boundary guard: an alternative that starts with a letter or digit must not be preceded by a letter or digit, and an alternative that ends in a digit must not be followed by a digit (so '4419' does not match inside '44190' and '24h' does not match inside '124h').
meta.source_rule: source=handbook when the value can be found in or computed from the handbook and/or employee profile alone; source=session when it appears only in a user message (lost if the conversation history is lost). Turn facts whose value only exists in a user message are tagged session too.
meta.ledger_exclusion_rule: No ledger-fact or probe alternative matches the normalised turn-10 user message of its session (checked in tests/test_cat3_quality_rerun.py).
meta.expected_display_note: probes[].expected_display is a readable form of the expected value for the app; it is never used for matching (any_of decides hits).
